No, a refund request isn't late at exactly 30 days. In `backend/app/rules.py`, `REFUND_WINDOW_DAYS = 30` and `late = days is not None and days > REFUND_WINDOW_DAYS`. The comment on that line says "exactly 30 days is still on time". The seed data in `backend/app/seed.py` agrees: order 1002, delivered 30 days ago, is marked "still on time", and order 1003 at 31 days is marked "late".

ANSWER: no
